correctness.rationale: Analytic derivation: exponential Brownian excursion is a difference of two exponentials; a convergent independent affine perpetuity gives unique stationarity. Gamma positive and negative tails force p,r≥1. Characteristic division identifies CY as a gamma difference with reduced shapes; sign agreement and an exact beta CDF identity force (p−1)/a=(r−1)/b. Direct beta-integral ODE proves sufficiency; compact-support even moments prove uniqueness of multiplier. Boundary p=r=1 and one-sided reduced-shape cases handled. 3,204 exact finite checker assertions supplement but do not replace proof.

value.rationale: Provides a complete sharp necessary-and-sufficient inverse classification, rather than an elementary fixed-point identity: nonzero drift locks the two gamma shapes to a unique ray, forbids all other shape pairs at natural scales, and uniquely identifies the beta reset multiplier. This is a motivated structural boundary for control of stochastic resetting equilibria.
